purpose: Self-contained on-demand review and evidence validation. No automatic certification, remediation, or release.

applicability_rules.any_of: Applicable if any named feature is true. Unknown if none is true and at least one is null or absent. Not applicable only if all are false and the assessment supplies evidence and rationale.
applicability_rules.unknown: Never silently skip unknown applicability. Individual controls may have a documented narrower applicability decision than their module; module selection is a discovery aid, not an automatic pass.

risk_based.meaning: The project owner sets a justified review interval for each applicable risk. A missing interval or assessed_at/valid_until prevents a current pass. Relevant changes invalidate evidence immediately, irrespective of the interval.

rules: Research never grants a release pass.
Unknown applicability or missing evidence for potentially critical controls prevents a green gate.
Only a designated gate owner can accept an exception or authorize release.
A pass requires current validation for every applicable control or a valid explicitly accepted exception.
Passing this catalog is scoped assurance, not a legal certification or a claim of complete security.
